ios.desc:
Join the ultimate sports connection hub with NockOut - your one-stop solution for all sports-related needs. NockOut is designed to bring sports enthusiasts together, making it easier than ever to connect with local players, discover venues, manage groups, and enhance your sports experience. Whether you're looking to play a casual game of badminton, organize a football match, or seek expert advice to improve your fitness plan, NockOut has got you covered.

Key Features:

Connect with Local Players and Groups
1. Find playpals and groups** in your area based on your skill level, sports interests, and availability.
2. Host or join games and challenge friends, players, and teams nearby.
3. Ensure your safety and privacy by controlling who you play with.
4. Invite friends to join NockOut and share your sports activities with them.
5. Form your team and manage RSVPs to keep track of attendees.**
6. Boost your sports profile by tracking your games and receiving ratings for your skills.

Discover and Book Venues
1. Easily discover and book sports facilities** and activity venues near you.
2. Choose from hourly bookings, session passes, or membership packages.**
3. Access detailed information about amenities, pricing, reviews, and ratings.
4. Enjoy confirmed and guaranteed bookings with the option for easy cancellations and refunds.**
5. Benefit from exclusive discounts and offers at your favorite venues.**

Learn and Improve
1. Access sports-based fitness programs and learn from professionals to enhance your game.**
2. Participate in master classes and community discussions to gain insights and tips.**
3. Explore curated content, blogs, and resources tailored to help you improve your skills.**

Manage Your Sports Life
1. Track your progress and consistency across different activities.
2. Integrate with HealthKit to monitor your fitness goals, including step count, calories burned, and heart rate.**
3. Compete with playpals through leaderboards and earn loyalty points from select clubs.**

Explore Activities and Events
1. Find exciting weekend activities, treks, marathons, and local events to participate in.**
2. Stay updated with real-time alerts and notifications for games and events.**


Note: ** Features Coming Soon

quotes.text:
Hey HN!

I'm an active sports player, and I've always struggled with the same problem: finding the right people and places to play my favorite sports. Whether it's a casual badminton match or a competitive basketball game, it usually ends up being frustrating and time-consuming. I kept noticing similar frustrations popping up online, too—people tweeting things like:

"Someone create an app that shows all public basketball courts and whether or not people are there. This would save me so much time lol."[1]

"I have wanted pickup hoops forever."[1]

So instead of waiting around, my team and I built NockOut. It's a platform that makes it super easy to:

Discover games based on your skill, location, and schedule.

Match with players who share your interests and skill level.

Join an active community of sports enthusiasts.

(Coming soon!) Book venues and courts with real-time availability.

We're in beta right now, and I'd love to get feedback from you all here on HN. Check it out at nockout.co or download the beta from the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/nockout/id6477323254).

Thanks so much for any feedback or suggestions—I'm excited to hear your thoughts and keep improving the platform!

[1] https://subramanya.ai/2024/01/11/the-nockout-story/
